result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Article 3) covering police-regulated occupations and businesses, sales tax operative date, definitions, and permit application procedures; no rental housing rules appear in this part.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only general business/police-permit provisions (San Diego Municipal Code §§ 32.59 through 33.0303). Although the source URL refers to a division on prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing (§ 98.1103), the text of that provision is not included in this part, so no rule in scope can be extracted from it. The rest of the document may contain it.
